leads.headline: US proposes 20% tariff on China in new duties on 14 trading partners
leads.sub: Rate stacks on ~25% existing duties; EU, Japan and Korea capped at 15% — USTR via Reuters

leads.headline: Iran's Guards say two tankers hit naval mines and caught fire in Hormuz
leads.sub: Tehran warned dark ships to coordinate passage; no independent confirmation — Reuters

leads.headline: Russian attack cuts power in 5 Ukrainian regions and halts a DTEK plant
leads.sub: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost external power for the 17th time this year — Reuters

small_cards.headline: Ukraine says Savasleyka strike damaged 5 warplanes — 3 MiG-31s, 2 Su-34s
small_cards.sub: Base east of Moscow in Nizhny Novgorod region; Russia did not comment — Reuters

small_cards.headline: Houthis say they hit Ras Tanura and Riyadh as Saudis downed 4 drones
small_cards.sub: 11 were wounded Tuesday in a strike on the same Riyadh tower — Reuters

small_cards.headline: Israeli strike kills Hamas chief Abuelouf, his wife and 2 children
small_cards.sub: Beach camp apartment hit early Wednesday; 2nd senior official killed in 24h — Reuters

small_cards.headline: Asian stocks tumble: MSCI Asia-Pacific falls 2.3%, Korea as much as 5.3%
small_cards.sub: Taiwan -5.1%, Nikkei -2.9% at worst points; early readings, not closes — Reuters

small_cards.headline: US inflation hits 3.8% as Q3 growth is revised up to 4.3%
small_cards.sub: Core PCE rose 3.3% year on year; spending rose 0.3% in October — BEA via Reuters

small_cards.headline: RSF drone attacks kill 19 people in Sudan's Blue Nile state
small_cards.sub: Strikes hit 3 Damazin neighbourhoods Tuesday night; 20+ wounded — Al Jazeera

small_cards.headline: Russia's own records put its Ukraine war dead at 490,334, BBC finds
small_cards.sub: With the missing, the toll tops 700,000; the Kremlin replied Wednesday — BBC

small_cards.headline: Shenzhou-24 takes Pakistani pilot Zeeshan Ali to Tiangong, a first
small_cards.sub: Launched 08:18 Beijing time from Jiuquan; Ali stays 5 to 10 days — Reuters

small_cards.headline: Australia wins defence-partner pact with Solomon Islands
small_cards.sub: Deal bars a foreign military base and sidelines China's 2022 pact — Reuters

small_cards.headline: Colombian forces storm Cartagena shop, free all hostages, kill 1 captor
small_cards.sub: President De La Espriella confirmed the rescue; the siege began Tuesday — AFP
